visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a POV shot of a male hand gesturing within a narrow hallway of a house under renovation. The environment is cluttered with wooden boards, a blue electric fan, and a ladder leaning against a wall of bare drywall. The ceiling is exposed, showing silver air ducts and unfinished wooden framing, while the floor is covered in protective paper and tape. (2) The camera moves into a larger open-plan living area where the lighting is warm and cast from temporary overhead bulbs. Several white sacks of construction material are stacked near a large window looking out onto a dark night scene. A central wooden work table is visible, surrounded by scrap wood and building tools. (3) Shifting to the kitchen and dining zone, the narrator's hand points to a long wooden counter structure. An air compressor sits on the dusty floor, and bundles of wires hang from the unfinished ceiling. The walls are white but marked with pencil notes and technical diagrams taped in a row near the window. (4) The tour continues into a smaller bedroom where several large wooden panels lean against the wall. The room is mostly empty with a single window and exposed ceiling fixtures. The camera pans across the space, highlighting the progress of the wall installation and the relocated doorway. (5) Entering a very narrow room identified as a workspace, the walls are clean white drywall with a small window at the far end. The person's hand gestures to indicate the placement of a future desk and cabinets. The floor is tiled and relatively clean compared to the previous living spaces. (6) In the second bedroom, a large white wardrobe structure is already built into the wall. A large wooden board sits on the floor, and the camera explores the corner where a bed will eventually be placed. The lighting remains bright and warm throughout the room. (7) Moving into the master bedroom, the largest of the sleeping quarters, the camera shows a high-set window and various electrical conduits hanging from the ceiling. A recessed area for a closet is visible, and technical drawings are again visible on the walls for reference. (8) The video concludes by returning to the main living area, providing a panoramic view of the entire layout. The space feels more open as the camera sweeps across the connected kitchen and living room, emphasizing the scale of the finished framing and the nighttime view outside.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal progress update for a home renovation project. The narrator takes the audience through each room of his unfinished apartment, explaining the current state of construction and the planned layout for his family. The high-energy narration and upbeat music aim to share the excitement of building a new home and to provide a clear spatial overview of the property.
